senses.gloss: श्लोक् vt. 1Ā (pres. श्लोकते) 1. To compose in verse, to versify; 2. to acquire; 3. to abandon, to relinquish.

श्लोक m. 1. A stanza in general; 2. a stanza, written in the Anushtubh metre; 3. praising, praise; 4. an object of praise; 5. celebrity, fame, renown, e.g. पुण्यश्लोको नलो राजा पुण्यश्लोको युधिष्ठिरः; 6. a proverb, a saying.
श्लोण् vt. 1P (pres. श्लोणति) To accumulate, to heap together.
